conflicts_and_limits: No gh-aw/APM code inspected or executed; source capability claims cannot certify native enforcement.
Unicode scanning cannot rule out ordinary-text prompt injection.
Abbreviated lockfile SHA and version-tag imports are illustrations, not exact reviewed executable identity.
Instruction isolation cannot override higher-priority legitimate organizational/user constraints.
Policy deny-star precedence, tighten-only inheritance and proxy-only routing require actual implementation verification.
Network customizations, organization runner enforcement and ARC/DinD compatibility are explicit pinned gaps; roadmap is not delivery.
No complete audit or reproducibility story is established merely by Actions runs.
